analysis_status: post-outcome referee-led identification audit; serialized before D02 output execution and not a preregistration

requirement.title: Adjudicate separate age-regression decomposition
requirement.scope: Identification geometry only; no coefficient, protected outcome, sampling inference, or row-level data is used.

governing_documents.governing_rule: EXECUTION_PROMPT_V3 section 8.1 and UNDERSTANDING_CONTRACT section 7 require that unrestricted occupation-by-month effects be rejected in a single-age exposure-by-post model.

canonical_spec.role: frozen V3 canonical model and 113-month static calendar contract

membership.role: frozen 468-occupation Rule-A beta quintile and Webb membership metadata

support_accounting_spec.role: Gate 2 support/accounting contract that authenticates the same membership and observed calendar

support_accounting_receipt.role: authoritative Gate 2 metadata receipt; protected aggregate itself is neither needed nor opened

support_accounting_validation.role: post-run validation binding the support/accounting receipt, 468 occupations, and 114 observed months

membership.input_limit: Membership metadata only; the runner has no argument for protected stocks, outcomes, or row-level records.

design.row_unit: one row per frozen occupation and included calendar month in a single age-specific stock panel
design.post_definition: 1 for 2023-01 through 2026-07 among included months and 0 otherwise
design.q1_normalization: Q1-by-post is omitted; q2_post through q5_post are relative to Q1.

invalid_saturated_nuisance.terms: unrestricted occupation-by-calendar-month indicators, one for every single-age panel row
invalid_saturated_nuisance.disposition: invalid because it absorbs every exposure-by-post column and leaves the target unidentified

possible_companion.estimand: For each age group separately, a log-stock quasi-Poisson projection with its own coefficient vector.
possible_companion.nuisance: additive occupation fixed effects plus additive calendar-month fixed effects; no occupation-by-month interaction
possible_companion.common_normalization: same included calendar, fixed membership, post definition, Q1 omission, and Webb-z normalization in both age regressions
possible_companion.status: possible companion estimand subject to a separate outcome-bearing specification and execution; not executed here

proof_contract.method: Construct the exact ordered row-key to nuisance-pivot bijection. For row r=(o,t), the occupation-by-month indicator indexed by the same key is one at r and zero elsewhere.
proof_contract.factorization: For every declared exposure-by-post column X_k, set B[pivot(o,t),k]=X[(o,t),k], so X=ZB exactly.
proof_contract.companion_geometry: On the balanced panel, residualizing e_o post_t against additive occupation and month effects gives (e_o-mean_o e)(post_t-mean_t post); rank is checked on only the centered 468-by-5 occupation feature matrix.

interpretation.invalid_model: The saturated single-age occupation-by-month nuisance is inadmissible for the requested exposure-by-post contrast.
interpretation.possible_companion: The separately defined additive occupation-plus-month model changes the nuisance space and therefore changes the projection estimand.
interpretation.age_coefficient_additivity: Separate age-specific coefficients need not add to the nonlinear grouped-binomial headline.
interpretation.identity_claim: No coefficient additivity identity is claimed or forced; any future identity requires a derivation and an outcome-bearing matched execution.

outputs.result_id_rule: SHA-256 over canonical JSON containing spec_id, logical filename, and artifact SHA-256
outputs.receipt_id_rule: SHA-256 over canonical receipt JSON after removing only receipt_id
